meaning.en: now, therefore
meaning.hi: अब, इसके बाद

meaning.en: we will explain the Advayataraka Upanishad
meaning.hi: हम अद्वयतारक उपनिषद् को समझाएँगे

meaning.en: for a renunciate who has conquered his senses
meaning.hi: उस संन्यासी के लिए जिसने इन्द्रियाँ जीत ली हैं

meaning.en: who is complete in the six qualities beginning with calm
meaning.hi: जो शांति आदि छह गुणों से पूर्ण है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: always holding the thought "I am, by nature, pure awareness"
meaning.hi: सदा यह भाव रखते हुए "मैं चेतना-स्वरूप हूँ"

meaning.en: with the eyes properly closed
meaning.hi: आँखें ठीक से बंद किए

meaning.en: or held a little bit open
meaning.hi: या थोड़ी-सी खुली रखे

meaning.en: with inward gaze, from the space above and behind the eyebrows
meaning.hi: भीतरी दृष्टि से, भौंहों के पीछे की जगह से ऊपर

meaning.en: beholding the supreme brahman, the peak of being-awareness-bliss-radiance
meaning.hi: सत्-चित्-आनंद-तेज के शिखर स्वरूप परब्रह्म को देखते हुए

meaning.en: he becomes that very form
meaning.hi: वह उसी रूप में बदल जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: it carries a person across the fear of the womb, birth, old age, and death
meaning.hi: यह गर्भ, जन्म, बुढ़ापे और मृत्यु के भय से पार उतारता है

meaning.en: therefore it is called taraka, the crossing
meaning.hi: इसीलिए इसे तारक कहा जाता है

meaning.en: understanding that the individual soul and God are both products of maya
meaning.hi: यह जानकर कि जीव और ईश्वर दोनों माया के हैं

meaning.en: setting aside every particular quality with "not this, not this"
meaning.hi: हर विशेष गुण को "नेति नेति" कहकर हटाकर

meaning.en: whatever remains is brahman, without a second
meaning.hi: जो बचता है वही अद्वय ब्रह्म है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: to accomplish that (realization)
meaning.hi: उसे सिद्ध करने के लिए

meaning.en: the careful pursuit of three objects of contemplation
meaning.hi: तीन ध्यान-विषयों का अनुसंधान

meaning.en: must be done
meaning.hi: करना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in the middle of the body is the brahma-channel, sushumna
meaning.hi: देह के बीच ब्रह्मनाड़ी सुषुम्ना है

meaning.en: sun-shaped, glowing like a full moon
meaning.hi: सूर्य के आकार की, पूर्ण चंद्र-आभा वाली

meaning.en: starting from the base, travelling to the crown opening
meaning.hi: मूलाधार से शुरू होकर ब्रह्मरंध्र तक जाने वाली

meaning.en: bright as ten million lightning flashes, fine as a lotus-thread, called kundalini
meaning.hi: करोड़ों बिजलियों जैसी दीप्ति, कमल-सूत्र जैसी सूक्ष्म, कुंडलिनी

words.sanskrit: tām dṛṣṭvā manasā eva naraḥ sarva-pāpa-vināśa-dvārā muktaḥ bhavati

meaning.en: seeing her with the mind alone, a person becomes free through the wearing away of every wrong
meaning.hi: उसे मन से देखकर आदमी सब पाप के नाश के द्वार से मुक्त हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: phāla-ūrdhva-galalāṭa-viśeṣa-maṇḍale nirantaram tejaḥ tāraka-yoga-visphuraṇena paśyati cet siddhaḥ bhavati

meaning.en: if he keeps seeing unbroken light at the brow-circle arising from taraka-yoga, he has arrived
meaning.hi: अगर वह भौंहों के घेरे में तारक-योग से उठता अटूट उजाला देखे, तो वह सिद्ध है

meaning.en: with forefinger tips placed in both ear-openings, a whistling sound arises there
meaning.hi: तर्जनी के सिरे कानों में रखने पर वहाँ सीटी जैसी आवाज़ उठती है

meaning.en: mind held there, looking at the place of blue light in the middle of the eyes
meaning.hi: मन वहाँ थामकर आँखों के बीच की नीली ज्योति देखते हुए

meaning.en: through inward looking he reaches a happiness beyond which there is nothing
meaning.hi: भीतरी नज़र से वह ऐसे सुख तक पहुँचता है जिससे आगे कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: he sees it in the heart in the same way
meaning.hi: वह हृदय में भी वैसे ही देखता है

meaning.en: this is the mark of the inward object of contemplation, to be practised by those seeking liberation
meaning.hi: यही भीतरी ध्यान-विषय का लक्षण है, मुमुक्षुओं द्वारा उपास्य

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: now the mark of the outward object of contemplation
meaning.hi: अब बाहरी ध्यान-विषय का लक्षण

words.sanskrit: nāsikā-agre catur-bhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ aṣṭabhiḥ daśabhiḥ dvādaśabhiḥ kramāt aṅgula-alante

meaning.en: in front of the nose-tip, at four, six, eight, ten, twelve finger-widths in order
meaning.hi: नाक की नोक के आगे चार, छह, आठ, दस, बारह उँगली पर क्रम से

words.sanskrit: nīla-dyuti-śyāmatva-sadṛk-rakta-bhaṅgī-sphurat-pīta-varṇa-dvaya-upetam vyoma yadi paśyati sa tu yogī bhavati

meaning.en: if he sees a space carrying blue light, a matching dark shade, a red streak, and two yellows, he is a yogi
meaning.hi: अगर वह नीली झलक, गहरी छाँह, लाल लकीर और दो पीली आभाओं वाला आकाश देखे, तो वह योगी है

words.sanskrit: cala-dṛṣṭyā vyoma-bhāga-vīkṣituḥ puruṣasya dṛṣṭy-agre jyotir-mayūkhāḥ vartate

meaning.en: for one whose gaze travels over that space, rays of light stand before his sight
meaning.hi: जो नज़र उस आकाश पर घुमाता है, उसके सामने उजाले की किरणें खड़ी होती हैं

meaning.en: by seeing that he becomes a yogi
meaning.hi: उसे देखने से वह योगी हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: tapta-kāñcana-saṅkāśa-jyotir-mayūkhāḥ apāṅga-ante bhūmau vā paśyati tad-dṛṣṭiḥ sthirā bhavati

meaning.en: catching rays like heated gold at the eye's corner or on the ground, his gaze becomes steady
meaning.hi: तपे सोने जैसी किरणें आँख के कोने या ज़मीन पर देखे तो नज़र स्थिर हो जाती है

meaning.en: for one who gazes steadily twelve finger-widths above the head, there is deathlessness
meaning.hi: सिर से बारह उँगली ऊपर नज़र टिकाने वाले के लिए अमरता है

words.sanskrit: yatra kutra sthitasya śirasi vyoma-jyotiḥ dṛṣṭam cet sa tu yogī bhavati

meaning.en: wherever he stands, if that space's light is seen above his head, he is a yogi
meaning.hi: जहाँ भी खड़ा हो, अगर उसके सिर के ऊपर वह उजाला दिखे तो वह योगी है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: now the mark of the middle object of contemplation
meaning.hi: अब बीच के ध्यान-विषय का लक्षण

meaning.en: in the morning he sees it like a colourful whole sun-wheel, like a row of flames, then like empty space
meaning.hi: सुबह वह रंगीन पूरे सूर्य-चक्र जैसा, फिर लपटों की क़तार जैसा, फिर ख़ाली आकाश जैसा देखता है

meaning.en: he rests, taking on that very shape
meaning.hi: वह उसी आकार में ठहर जाता है

meaning.en: seeing it again and again, it becomes a space without any quality
meaning.hi: बार-बार देखने से वह गुणरहित आकाश बन जाता है

meaning.en: it becomes the highest space, deep as dense darkness lit by a shining star's shape
meaning.hi: वह परम आकाश बन जाता है, गाढ़े अँधेरे जैसा पर चमकते तारे के आकार से दीप्त

meaning.en: it becomes the vast space, glowing like the fire at the end of an age
meaning.hi: वह महाकाश बन जाता है, युगांत की आग जैसा दीप्त

meaning.en: it becomes the space of the elements, shining with the highest brightness
meaning.hi: वह तत्त्व-आकाश बन जाता है, सर्वोच्च दीप्ति से चमकता

meaning.en: it becomes the sun-space, glowing with the splendour of ten million suns
meaning.hi: वह सूर्य-आकाश बन जाता है, करोड़ों सूरजों की भव्यता से चमकता

meaning.en: so these five spaces, outer and inner, are what taraka has in view
meaning.hi: ये पाँच बाहरी-भीतरी आकाश ही तारक का ध्यान-विषय हैं

meaning.en: one who sees them gains liberation as fruit, and becomes like that same space
meaning.hi: इन्हें देखने वाला मुक्ति फल पाता है और उसी आकाश जैसा हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: tasmāt tāraka eva lakṣyam amanaska-phala-pradam bhavati

meaning.en: so taraka alone is the object of contemplation, granting the fruit of amanaska
meaning.hi: इसलिए तारक ही अमनस्क फल देने वाला ध्यान-विषय है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that taraka is of two kinds
meaning.hi: वह तारक दो तरह का है

meaning.en: the first half is taraka itself
meaning.hi: पहला आधा तारक ही है

meaning.en: the second half is amanaska
meaning.hi: दूसरा आधा अमनस्क है

meaning.en: there is a verse on this point
meaning.hi: इस पर एक श्लोक है

words.sanskrit: tat yogam ca dvidhā viddhi pūrva-uttara-vidhānataḥ

meaning.en: know this yoga to be two-fold, by the rule for the earlier and later stage
meaning.hi: इस योग को पूर्व-उत्तर विधान से दो जानो

words.sanskrit: pūrvam tu tārakam vidyāt amanaskam tat-uttaram iti

meaning.en: understand taraka as the earlier, amanaska as what follows it
meaning.hi: तारक को पहला और अमनस्क को बाद वाला समझो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: taraka-yoga has, as its single fruit, seeing the moon and sun as one
meaning.hi: तारक-योग का एक ही फल है चाँद-सूरज को एक देखना

meaning.en: within the eyes, in the pupils, the moon and sun are reflected
meaning.hi: आँखों के भीतर, पुतलियों में, चाँद-सूरज परावर्तित होते हैं

meaning.en: through the pupils, seeing the two discs of sun and moon
meaning.hi: पुतलियों से सूर्य-चंद्र मंडल का दर्शन

words.sanskrit: brahmāṇḍam iva piṇḍāṇḍa-śiro-madhya-stha-ākāśe ravi-indu-maṇḍala-dvitayam asti iti niścitya

meaning.en: concluding that the space in the head of this small body holds a pair of sun-moon discs just as the cosmos does
meaning.hi: यह तय करते हुए कि सिर के भीतर का आकाश भी ब्रह्मांड की तरह सूर्य-चंद्र का जोड़ा रखता है

meaning.en: through the pupils, that seeing
meaning.hi: पुतलियों से वह दर्शन

meaning.en: here too, seeing the two as one, one should meditate with mind engaged
meaning.hi: यहाँ भी दोनों को एक देखते हुए मन लगाकर ध्यान करे

meaning.en: for without that union, there is no room for the senses' outward movement to be checked
meaning.hi: उस मिलन के बिना इन्द्रियों के भागने की गुंजाइश बनी रहती है

meaning.en: so, through inward looking, taraka alone is to be pursued
meaning.hi: इसलिए भीतरी नज़र से तारक ही अनुसंधान योग्य है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: it is to be pursued as two-fold, split by form and formlessness
meaning.hi: मूर्त-अमूर्त भेद से इसे दो तरह जानना है

words.sanskrit: tārakam dvividham mūrti-tārakam amūrti-tārakam ca iti

meaning.en: taraka is two-fold: with form, and without form
meaning.hi: तारक दो तरह का है: मूर्त और अमूर्त

meaning.en: whatever stops at the senses has form
meaning.hi: जो इन्द्रियों पर रुकता है उसका रूप है

meaning.en: whatever lies beyond the pair of eyebrows has no form
meaning.hi: जो भौंहों के जोड़े से परे है उसका रूप नहीं

meaning.en: everywhere, in discerning the inner reality, practice with mind engaged is required
meaning.hi: हर जगह भीतरी तत्त्व को पहचानने में मन-सहित अभ्यास चाहिए

words.sanskrit: tārakābhyām tad-ūrdhva-stha-sattva-darśanāt mano-yuktena antarīkṣaṇena sat-cit-ānanda-svarūpam brahma eva

meaning.en: through the pupils, by mind-engaged inward looking, one sees the reality above them, which is brahman itself
meaning.hi: पुतलियों से, मन-सहित भीतरी नज़र से, उनसे ऊपर के सत् को देखना — वही ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: so it is settled that brahman is made of white radiance
meaning.hi: तो यह तय हुआ कि ब्रह्म शुक्ल तेज का बना है

meaning.en: that brahman becomes knowable through inward looking, with eye and mind joined
meaning.hi: वह ब्रह्म आँख और मन के साथ मिलकर भीतरी नज़र से जाना जाता है

meaning.en: the same holds for the formless taraka too
meaning.hi: यही बिना-रूप तारक के साथ भी है

words.sanskrit: mano-yuktena cakṣuṣā eva dahara-ādikam vedyam bhavati

meaning.en: only through an eye joined with mind does the heart-space and the like become knowable
meaning.hi: मन-सहित आँख से ही हृदय-आकाश आदि जाना जाता है

meaning.en: since the purpose of grasping a form depends on mind and eye
meaning.hi: रूप ग्रहण करने का प्रयोजन मन और आँख पर टिका होने से

words.sanskrit: bāhyavat antare api ātma-manaḥ-cakṣuḥ-saṁyogena eva rūpa-grahaṇa-kārya-udayāt

meaning.en: just as outside, so within: grasping a form arises only when self, mind, and eye are joined
meaning.hi: जैसे बाहर वैसे भीतर: आत्मा, मन और आँख के जुड़ने से ही रूप-ग्रहण होता है

meaning.en: so mind-engaged inward looking is what brings taraka to light
meaning.hi: इसलिए मन-सहित भीतरी नज़र ही तारक को उजागर करती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the gaze in the small hollow between the two eyebrows
meaning.hi: दोनों भौंहों के बीच के गड्ढे में नज़र

meaning.en: through that doorway the light standing above emerges — this is taraka-yoga
meaning.hi: उसी द्वार से ऊपर खड़ा उजाला प्रकट होता है — यही तारक-योग है

meaning.en: uniting taraka well with that, with mind engaged
meaning.hi: मन-सहित तारक को उससे अच्छी तरह जोड़कर

words.sanskrit: prayatnena bhrū-yugmam sāvadhānatayā kiñcit ūrdhvam utkṣepayet

meaning.en: with effort, carefully, lift the pair of eyebrows a little upward
meaning.hi: प्रयत्न से, सावधानी से, भौंहों को थोड़ा ऊपर उठाए

meaning.en: this is the earlier taraka-yoga
meaning.hi: यह पहला तारक-योग है

words.sanskrit: uttaram tu amūrtimat amanaskam iti ucyate

meaning.en: the one after it is called the formless amanaska
meaning.hi: इसके बाद वाला अमूर्त अमनस्क कहलाता है

meaning.en: above the root of the palate there is a great ray of light
meaning.hi: तालु की जड़ के ऊपर उजाले की एक बड़ी किरण है

meaning.en: that is to be held in mind by yogis
meaning.hi: उसे योगियों को ध्यान में रखना है

meaning.en: from it come the powers beginning with becoming infinitesimally small
meaning.hi: उससे अणिमा आदि सिद्धियाँ उपजती हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: when the gaze rests on the object, inward or outward
meaning.hi: जब नज़र भीतरी या बाहरी विषय पर टिकी हो

meaning.en: and no longer opens and closes
meaning.hi: और खुलना-बंद होना छोड़ चुकी हो

meaning.en: that is truly the shambhavi seal
meaning.hi: वही सचमुच शांभवी मुद्रा है

meaning.en: wherever a knower established in that seal lives, the ground becomes pure
meaning.hi: उस मुद्रा में स्थापित ज्ञानी जहाँ रहता है वह भूमि शुद्ध हो जाती है

meaning.en: by his looking, all the worlds become pure
meaning.hi: उसके देखने से सारे लोक शुद्ध हो जाते हैं

words.sanskrit: tādṛśa-parama-yogi-pūjā yasya labhyate saḥ api muktaḥ bhavati

meaning.en: whoever gets to serve such a great yogi is also set free
meaning.hi: जिसे ऐसे महान योगी की सेवा मिले वह भी मुक्त हो जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the inward object of contemplation is, by nature, a burning light
meaning.hi: भीतरी ध्यान-विषय स्वभाव से जलता उजाला है

meaning.en: guided by the highest teacher's instruction
meaning.hi: सबसे बड़े गुरु के उपदेश से

meaning.en: it may be the burning light at the thousand-petalled place
meaning.hi: सहस्रार में जलता उजाला हो सकता है

meaning.en: or the light of awareness set in the cave of understanding
meaning.hi: या बुद्धि की गुफा में रखा चेतना का उजाला

meaning.en: or the fourth state of consciousness standing at the end of the sixteen
meaning.hi: या सोलह के अंत में खड़ी तुरीय चेतना

meaning.en: that is the inward object of contemplation
meaning.hi: वही भीतरी ध्यान-विषय है

meaning.en: seeing it is rooted in having a true teacher
meaning.hi: उसका दिखना सच्चे गुरु पर जड़ से टिका है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the teacher is complete in the Veda
meaning.hi: गुरु वेद से संपन्न है

meaning.en: devoted to Vishnu
meaning.hi: विष्णु-भक्त

meaning.en: free of spite or envy
meaning.hi: ईर्ष्यारहित

meaning.en: knows yoga and is established in yoga
meaning.hi: योग को जानने वाला और योग में स्थापित

meaning.en: always made of yoga, and pure
meaning.hi: सदा योगमय, शुद्ध

meaning.en: bound by devotion to his own teacher
meaning.hi: गुरु-भक्ति से युक्त

meaning.en: and above all, knows what a person truly is
meaning.hi: और सबसे बढ़कर पुरुष को जानने वाला

meaning.en: one in whom these marks are all present
meaning.hi: जिसमें ये सब लक्षण मौजूद हों

meaning.en: is the one the word guru is used for
meaning.hi: उसी के लिए गुरु शब्द इस्तेमाल होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the sound gu would mean darkness
meaning.hi: गु शब्द अँधेरा है

meaning.en: the sound ru is what blocks that darkness
meaning.hi: रु शब्द उसे रोकने वाला है

meaning.en: because he is the blocking-back of darkness
meaning.hi: अँधेरे को रोकने के कारण

meaning.en: the word guru is used for him
meaning.hi: उसे गुरु कहा जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the teacher is the supreme brahman
meaning.hi: गुरु ही परब्रह्म है

meaning.en: the teacher is the highest path
meaning.hi: गुरु ही सबसे ऊँचा मार्ग है

meaning.en: the teacher is the supreme knowledge
meaning.hi: गुरु ही सर्वोच्च विद्या है

meaning.en: the teacher is the final destination
meaning.hi: गुरु ही अंतिम मंज़िल है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the teacher is the farthest boundary
meaning.hi: गुरु ही सबसे दूर की सीमा है

meaning.en: the teacher is the greatest wealth
meaning.hi: गुरु ही सबसे बड़ा धन है

meaning.en: because he is the one who hands over that teaching
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वही वह शिक्षा सौंपने वाला है

meaning.en: therefore the teacher is heavier than the heaviest
meaning.hi: इसलिए गुरु सबसे भारी है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever recites it even once
meaning.hi: जो इसे एक बार भी उच्चारता है

meaning.en: is released from the cycle of birth and death
meaning.hi: वह संसार से मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: whatever wrong done across all births is destroyed that very instant
meaning.hi: सारे जन्मों का किया पाप उसी क्षण नष्ट हो जाता है

meaning.en: he gains everything he desires
meaning.hi: वह सारी इच्छाएँ पा लेता है

meaning.en: every human goal is accomplished
meaning.hi: हर पुरुषार्थ सिद्ध हो जाता है

meaning.en: so it is for whoever knows this; that is the secret teaching
meaning.hi: जो यह जानता है उसके लिए ऐसा ही है; यही उपनिषद् है
